text_block_list.text:
I rushed the injured Bubble Gum Fellow to 
the nurse's office and had her treated.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that feels a lot better. Taking care 
of things early really is important.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's get right back to training!
choice_data_list: No, no, that's way too reckless.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...If I stand around here, I'll fall 
behind the other girls.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I understand that overdoing it 
is forbidden and we shouldn't let our 
guard down, but—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I want to be someone who is always blazing 
the trail at the forefront!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
choice_data_list:
All the more reason to focus on 
recovering.

text_block_list.text:
If continuing training makes the injury 
worse, all our efforts will be for 
nothing. Besides, even if you fall a 
little behind—
choice_data_list: You can definitely make a comeback!
You can definitely turn this around.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Okay. If you're willing to go that far 
for me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's a shame, but it looks like we'll just 
have to give up for now...

Bubble Gum Fellow rested quietly, 
dedicating herself to treating her injury.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Let's be careful and take it one 
step at a time!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, this is bad. Just walking makes 
the pain get worse and worse.
choice_data_list: Let's call it off after all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
True, in this state, training is out of 
the question.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
How pathetic of me, after forcing my way 
through like that...

Bubble Gum Fellow's injury was slow to 
heal, and it took a long time for her to 
regain top form.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, aside from the injury, everything 
else seems totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
With this, it looks like you can jump 
right back into full training!

Bubble Gum Fellow worked out within limits 
that wouldn't affect her injury, making a 
smooth and steady recovery.
